data.one_liner: Play system sounds and beeps without requiring local sound files.
data.what_it_does: Allows Flutter apps to trigger native system beeps and custom system sounds on Android and iOS. It does not require bundling any audio files with the application.
use_when: You need to play standard success or failure beep sounds.
You want to trigger platform-specific system sounds without adding asset files.
avoid_when: You need to play complex background music or custom audio tracks.
You require fine-grained playback control like pausing, looping, or streaming audio.
strengths: Extremely lightweight with no sound files required.
Supports custom Android and iOS system sound IDs.
weaknesses: Limited to system sounds and beeps.
data.minimal_example: RaisedButton( child: Text("Beep Success"), onPressed: ()=> FlutterBeep.beep())
